claims.statement: Management reiterates 20%+ revenue growth guidance for FY25 and beyond with CASA, CMS and digital as growth drivers
PBT growth guidance maintained at 1.5x revenue growth percentage (30%+ PBT growth on 20% revenue growth) after factoring digital and technology investments
FY24 technology and digital capex spend was INR103 crores; similar annual capex expected for next 12-18 months for SFB preparation and core banking migration
Migration from FIS to Finacle core banking platform and hollowing of core architecture in progress, likely to complete in FY25
CASA accounts crossed 1 crore with 31.8 lakh new accounts in FY24; renewal income grew 75% YoY to INR128 crores; 69% of customers active
CMS revenue grew 38% YoY to INR144 crores in FY24; NBFC and MFI sector contributed 62% of CMS throughput; company controls 1/3 of CMS market
Revenue margins range-bound at 31-33% per guidance; EBITDA margin improved to 13.5% in Q4 and 12.9% for FY24; PAT margin reached 5.8% in FY24
Digital services revenue contribution increased from 1% in Q4 FY23 to 9% in Q4 FY24; digital services carry higher margins than open banking
Revenue growth guidance increased from 20% to 25% for FY25
EBITDA margin increased to 12.2% in Q1 FY25 from 11.6% in Q1 FY24
CMS throughput grew 26% YoY to approximately INR 20,000 crores in Q1 FY25
Core banking system revamp on schedule to complete by end of FY25
Continued investment in technology, digital platform and people stack
Digital payment services EBITDA margin higher than other businesses due to limited operating expenses
Revenue growth guidance for FY25 enhanced to 25% from earlier 25% guidance; confident of maintaining ~25% growth for next couple of years
Expect H2 revenue and profit to be 5-7% higher than H1, consistent with past 3-year trend
Gross margin stable around 31% in Q2 and H1 FY25; EBITDA margin improved to 12.6% from 12.2% prior quarter; target double-digit PBT margin over next couple of years
Digital payment services gross margin ~20% but contributes materially to PBT due to low operating costs; renewal income growing 51% YoY compensating for moderating CASA/CMS margins
CASA customer base over 1.26 crore with ~70% active; adding ~2.75 lakh new accounts monthly; average deposits grew 34% YoY to INR1,696 crores
Merchant network expanded 22% YoY to 18.5 lakh; targeting additional 1.5-1.75 lakh merchants annually
Annual technology capex ~INR90 crores; total investment ~INR270 crores over past years; core banking migration to Finacle and Hollow the Core project underway, expected completion in 6 months
FY25 revenue growth guidance of 25% reaffirmed; on track to meet or exceed
No formal guidance given for FY26 or FY27 yet; may provide structured guidance in Q1
Cost-income ratio improved to 25.9% in Q3 FY25 from 27% a year ago
Gross margin improved ~70 bps due to remittance decline and digital mix shift; margins expected range-bound long term
CMS throughput reached 97.5% of FY24 full-year in 9M FY25; 231+ clients on platform
Technology capex INR120 cr in FY25 YTD vs INR80 cr in FY24; 50% increase; depreciated over 3-5 years
Core banking migration (Hollow-The-Core) testing started; expect go-live in 3-4 months
SFB license: RBI engagement increased; external committee formed Jan 20, 2025; plan to go live within 1 year of in-principle approval
Capex includes CWIP - CBS migration ₹ 83 Crs
